maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The four identified top-row keypoints are arranged in a near-linear horizontal distribution, positioned approximately 8-12 pixels superior to the primary dense row and maintaining a parallel orientation with no significant angular deviation.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The apex of the nose exhibits approximately 100% melanin saturation, appearing as a uniform cluster of dark pixels with no visible pink or depigmented regions.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: The profile follows a convex curve from the orbital ridge transitioning into a subtle concave dip at the bridge of the nose, forming a frontal slope of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the muzzle.

other_distinctive_markers: The mane displays a high-contrast bicoloration, characterized by tawny-orange fur on the anterior and facial regions and dark-brown/black fur on the dorsal and posterior segments.
